units.source_text: 岛村猜想：她是在自己睡着之后才到这里过夜的吧？

en.t: Shimamura wondered whether she had come here to spend the night only after he had fallen asleep.

units.source_text: 他扫视了一眼自己的睡铺，拿起枕边的手表一看，这才六点半钟。

en.t: He glanced over his own bedding, picked up the watch beside his pillow, and saw that it was only half past six.
